name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing backward.
Bend both elbows and curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders with your knuckles uppermost.
Lower the dumbbells until your arms straighten.
tips: Keep your wrists from bending as you lift.
Keep your elbows pinned near your sides without swinging your torso.
